headline: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals
sum: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals — Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of trading approval letter for listing of equity shares allotted…
